title: I Took the Dog-Daycare Late Fee to the Owner's Own Pickup Window

parts.text: I arrived at 5:59 p.m. for a 6:00 pickup and the desk was already filling out a late form because the clock on the wall was 6:04. I was thirty-three, holding a leash, looking at my phone's 5:59. The owner had written the policy: wall clock rules. I photographed both clocks and the form with my dog's name spelled wrong. Then I sat in the lot until 6:20, when the owner jogged in from her own errand with her own dog. The wall still said 6:24. Her staff did not start a form.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: Her own pickup is late on the wall clock and nobody has a form.

social.video_title: Wall clock billed me at 5:59 phone time — Part 1/2
social.description: Leash in hand, misspelled form, owner's errand. Staff froze. Would you have argued the minute?

parts.text: I asked for two forms or zero. They chose zero and reset the wall to phones. I paid nothing extra. My dog's name got letters. The owner laughed in a way that was not funny. Policy is a clock you also obey. I pick up at 5:50 now because trust is a resource. The wall and I agree. The leash clicked. We left on time in every remaining sense.

social.video_title: Two forms or zero — they chose zero — Part 2/2
social.description: Reset clock, correct spelling, 5:50 pickup. Was a wall a register?
